liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **That's It For The Other One** (3 reviews): Reviewer found the Other One disorganized; Quiet sections feature remarkable space-guitar interplay between Garcia and Weir, called unique among Other Ones [11][14][15]
- **Cosmic Charlie** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer found Cosmic Charlie rushed; On this recording, Cosmic Charlie is folded into the Other One segue track [1][11][16]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Pigpen plays harmonica on Truckin' [12]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Pigpen's harmonica appears on Dire Wolf, which the reviewer hadn't noticed before [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-01-21.131517.aud.miller.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 17 songs; 115 min; rated 3.29/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the sound is not good, though the playing is strong; Sound is rough or crusty, yet it conveys the feeling of being there; There are a couple of very short cuts in Truckin' [1][15][17]
- **gd1971-01-21.153417.sbd.partial.martin.smith.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 8 songs; 35 min [3]
- **gd1971-01-21.153406.sbd.partial.martin.smith.clugston.flac1648**: soundboard; 8 songs; 35 min [4]
- **gd1971-01-21.153470.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 6 songs; 27 min [5]

## Around the show

- New Riders of the Purple Sage opened; it was Steve Martin's first show [3]
- It was Steve Martin's first show; he asked Dick Latvala for a copy of the vault reels [4]
- New Riders of the Purple Sage opened the show [4]
- New Riders of the Purple Sage opened the show [5]
- Reviewer says organ was kept low in tape mixes until Europe 72, and checked this show for it [12]
- Reviewer ranks the Cryptical reprise into Cosmic Charlie transition alongside the 2/17/73 transition into China Cat [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-01-21.131517.aud.miller.flac16**: taped by Sandy Troy; transferred by Charlie Miller, Matt Smith, Joe B. Jones; source: AUD (Unknown Gear) -> ? -> Reel (Maxell UD 35-90 @ 3.75ips) [1]. Also: Missing parts are filled with soundboard material from the same show, going via master reel and DAT to CD [1]
- **gd1971-01-21.153417.sbd.partial.martin.smith.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Steve Martin; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard 1/2 Track Reels > Steve Martin's cassette [3]. Also: Martin asked Dick Latvala for a vault-reel copy; Latvala found only reels 2 and 4 and loaned them [3]
- **gd1971-01-21.153406.sbd.partial.martin.smith.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Steve Martin; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard 1/2 Track Reels > Steve Martin's cassette [4]
- **gd1971-01-21.153470.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [5]. Also: Audience source lacked Mama Tried, so a soundboard filler version was included; No other Uncle John's Band version existed, so it was left off; mixed by an archive.org user [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Freeborn Hall - Univ. of California Davis](https://www.dead.net/archives/1971/artwork/freeborn-hall-univ-california-davis) [19]
